scene: Ancient Egyptian Nile valley during the annual inundation. A calm swollen river has spread shallow silty water across a wide flat low floodplain. Sparse reeds emerge at the edge; dry pale desert rises gently beyond. Emphasize natural water spreading over low ground, not a destructive rushing wave. No people, buildings, monuments or cultivated grids. No before-and-after comparison.
alt: A swollen river spreads shallow water across a low floodplain, with reeds at the edge and dry desert beyond.
